snippet.title: Our Adventurer Guild | Xbox Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Our Adventurer Guild is now available on Xbox One & Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/our-adventurer-guild/9nmx1v5j2jgw

⚔️ Your legacy begins now. As the new Guild Master, the fate of a fallen Adventurer Guild rests in your hands. Will you restore its glory—or watch it crumble forever?

In Our Adventurer Guild, manage your guild, recruit and develop unique adventurers, and send them on dangerous quests. Lead your party in turn-based, grid-based tactical battles, manage morale and relationships, craft powerful gear, and shape heroes through deep class progression. Every decision leaves a mark on your guild’s future.

#XboxSeriesX #XboxOne #OurAdventurerGuild #RPG
